title: EEG: Simon Conflict in Parkinson's
description: EEG dataset from a Simon conflict task with a cost-of-conflict reinforcement manipulation, recorded in 28 patients with Parkinson's disease and 28 matched healthy controls. Patients were tested twice, one week apart, ON and OFF dopaminergic medication, while controls were tested once. Accelerometer data from the most tremor-affected hand are also included, along with task code and analysis scripts.
methods_description: Data were collected around 2015 at the Cognitive Rhythms and Computation Lab, University of New Mexico. Participants performed a Matlab-based Simon conflict task with reinforcement manipulation while EEG was recorded. Parkinson's patients completed two sessions a week apart, ON and OFF medication, and controls completed one. A triaxial accelerometer (X, Y, Z) was taped to the most tremor-affected hand.
